draft.transcript:
Good afternoon, this is Dr. Amara Ochieng, Director of the Livestock Genetics and Health Directorate, with my update for Quarter 2, 2026.
Overall status: green.
We are at seventy-eight percent progress against our Q2 milestones.
Key success: we completed validation of the new genotyping panel for indigenous cattle breeds two weeks ahead of schedule.
Key challenge: the shipment of reference reagents from our European supplier was delayed by three weeks due to a customs issue, which pushed back one sub-activity.
Support needed: we would appreciate corporate procurement support to help pre-clear future reagent shipments through customs more quickly.
That's my update for this quarter.
